native_precision: FP32, autocast/TF32 disabled, then FP16 cache-equivalent output
ATSP_roles: Fixed identity onehot first N of256, zero FROM; identical in arms and datasets; N>256 rejected
ATSP_features: Normalize FROM256 and TO256 separately, concatenate, project512to128; never average or subtract
source_pretraining_instance_overlap: unknown; external pretraining budget is not matched to scratch
RDrop: Original two same-parameter dropout views, linear4320 update ramp; no new objective
task_and_row_streams: Original natural full18 seed2 streams, identical A/B logical batches
initialization: Same fresh R84 seed2 state and TRAIN-only geometry; no trained selector loaded
selection_rule: Strict minimum complete18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct with common fullTRAIN SBS, first wins ties
inference: Original score MLP, utility differences and maximin; no temperature, quota, ensemble or expert trigger
TEST_LIB_policy: Unique VAL lock per whole arm before fixed full TEST/LIB; no test-dependent reselection or per-problem stitching
historical_TEST_exposure: Previously used in development, not a fully blind research benchmark
routing_cache_policy: DIRECT read-only original R94B reuse in BOTH arms; no copy or re-extraction; TEST only after new VAL lock
extra_feature_preparation: Exact valid N, original physical node order; TRAIN/VAL before training, TEST after own VAL lock; batch128
online_timing: Strip both donor cache fields every repeat; count real donor invocation; separate cached-selector latency; GPU-resident batch amortized, not singleton/end-to-end
allocation: Existing1475 gpu05 container, CPU4/mem9GiB/one UUID per arm; shared node and GPU locks
publication: One curated whole-version commit/push after both arms complete locked TEST/LIB/PDF
